scope: The reviewed query-cost switch of the staging broker (plan row SD5 of docs/plan/store-data-foundation-implementation.md, docs/briefs/sd5-shopify-query-cost.md; Shopify's rate limit, counted in Shopify's GraphQL query-cost points, never money or credits). Committed off: the broker's shopifyRead (ApiBroker and RuntimeBroker) sends each fixed document as M2 PR-3 does, with its one THROTTLED wait, and never calls the bucket definers of migration shopify-query-cost (morrow_vault.shopify_query_cost_take and shopify_query_cost_settle), so no bucket row is written. It is turned on only by one reviewed commit that sets switch to on and adds MORROW_SHOPIFY_QUERY_COST "on" to the staging broker's vars, after the migration is applied: from then on each read takes its document's known query cost from its store installation's bucket before it is sent (person reads before agent reads, each class leaving the headroom the classes above it need, so a background read never takes what an approved write needs), waits in the broker or parks when the bucket cannot yet cover it (the catalogue routes answer 429 with Retry-After; a run's product read is tried again), and settles the bucket from the throttleStatus Shopify returns. edge:check refuses any mixed state; production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
